description: This Java class 'UtilCache' provides a generalized caching utility with features like capacity limits, expiration, soft references, and event listeners. It manages cache instances, tracks hit/miss statistics, and supports cache operations such as put, get, remove, and clear.

classes.name: UtilCache
classes.description: A thread-safe, serializable cache utility supporting capacity limits, expiration, soft references, and event listeners. Manages cache instances and provides core cache operations.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts or updates an element in the cache with optional expiration time.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.description: Inserts an element only if it is not already present in the cache.

methods.name: putIfAbsentAndGet
methods.description: Inserts an element if absent and returns the existing or new value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an element from the cache by key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the cache by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: setMaxInMemory
methods.description: Sets the maximum in-memory size of the cache.

methods.name: setSizeLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of elements in the cache.

methods.name: setExpireTime
methods.description: Sets the expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: setUseSoftReference
methods.description: Configures whether cache entries use soft references.

methods.name: getUseSoftReference
methods.description: Returns whether soft references are used for cache entries.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache.

methods.name: getCacheLineKeys
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of cache keys.
